description_en: Associates an API configuration with a specified API product by submitting the gatewayId and apigRefConfig parameters to the /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref endpoint. The association result can be queried by GetProductRef and removed by DeleteProductRef at the same path
description_zh: 为指定的 API 产品关联 API 配置：在 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref 上提交 gatewayId 与 apigRefConfig，关联结果可由同路径的 GetProductRef 查询、由 DeleteProductRef 解除
name: CreateProductRef

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API product. This parameter specifies the API product with which you want to associate the API configuration. You can obtain the ID from the productId field of a list item returned by ListProducts or from the productId field in the response of CreateProduct. This parameter uses the same /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref path as CreateProductRef, GetProductRef, and DeleteProductRef
parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，指定要关联 API 配置的 API 产品。可由 ListProducts 列表项的 productId 或 CreateProduct 响应的 productId 获得，与 CreateProductRef、GetProductRef、DeleteProductRef 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/ref 路径
parameters.name: product_id
